scope: Published documentation-research snapshot; not a fresh vendor API test.

app.description: Graph database and managed graph hosting
app.access_detail: Self-hosted database credentials; Aura management has separate client credentials and entitlements.
app.surface: HTTP Query API + Aura management; Cypher queries and infrastructure
app.note: Basic/Bearer database query auth and Aura OAuth are distinct; a graph database is not a GraphQL API.

mcp.scope: Schema introspection and Cypher read/write; database credentials and optional read-only mode

app.workflow: Run a read-only local Cypher query
app.next_action: Use a local Neo4j database and a read-only query identity to retrieve a small seeded graph through the Query API or MCP.
app.success_criterion: Return the expected nodes and relationships; document database auth separately from Aura management OAuth.
app.alternative_action: Keep graph query execution separate from infrastructure provisioning and constrain query/time limits.
app.status: Proposed; not an authenticated test result
